title: Gloss
description: Gloss: a JSON format for PDF annotations. Coordinates are PDF user space in points, origin bottom-left, before /Rotate.

format.description: Marks the file as Gloss. Always gloss.

version.description: The Gloss format version the document follows. Always 1 for this schema.

documentKey.description: Optional. Identifies the PDF the annotations belong to, in whatever form the writer and reader agree on.

annotations.description: The annotations, in drawing order. Each is a type Gloss defines or one it doesn't.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A Gloss document: the annotations on one PDF.

Annotation.title: Annotation
Annotation.description: Any annotation type Gloss defines, chosen by its type field.

id.description: Unique within the document. Never reused for a different annotation.

page.description: The page the annotation is on, counted from 0.

rect.description: The bounding box, in PDF user space.

color.description: The annotation's colour. Absent: the reader chooses the colour.

opacity.description: Opacity, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque). Absent means opaque.

author.description: Who made the annotation. Absent means unknown.

contents.description: The annotation's text, such as a comment or a note. Absent means no text.

inReplyTo.description: The id of the annotation this one replies to. Replies form threads. Absent means the annotation is not a reply.

createdAt.description: When the annotation was made, as an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. XFDF writes a PDF date string (D:20261019120000Z). Absent means unknown.

modifiedAt.description: When the annotation last changed, as an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. XFDF writes a PDF date string. Absent means unknown.

subject.description: A short label for what the mark is. Absent means no label.

intent.description: What the mark is for, such as a callout or an arrow. Absent means the type's plain form.

custom.description: Data of your own. Gloss readers keep it as it is and never interpret it. Absent means none.

quads.description: The runs of text the mark covers, one quad per line. At least one.

Highlight.title: Highlight
Highlight.description: A highlight over a run of text.

Rect.title: Rect
Rect.description: A rectangle in PDF user space, given by its bottom-left corner and its size. XFDF writes it as x1,y1,x2,y2.

Intent.title: Intent
Intent.description: What a mark is for, such as a callout or an arrow (XFDF intent, PDF /IT). One of FreeText, FreeTextCallout, FreeTextTypeWriter, LineArrow, LineDimension, PolygonCloud, PolygonDimension, PolyLineDimension. Any other PDF name is allowed and is kept unchanged.

Quad.title: Quad
Quad.description: A quadrilateral over a run of text, its corners in the order PDF uses for /QuadPoints. It need not be axis-aligned.

y.description: Vertical position in points, measured up from the bottom.

Point.title: Point
Point.description: A point in PDF user space: points, origin bottom-left, before /Rotate.

page.description: The page the annotation is on, counted from 0.

rect.description: The bounding box, in PDF user space.

color.description: The box's fill. Absent means no fill.

opacity.description: Opacity, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque). Absent means opaque.

contents.description: The text shown on the page.

width.description: The border's width in points; 0 draws no border. Absent means 0.

dashes.description: The dash pattern of the stroke. Absent means a solid line.

cornerRadius.description: The radius of the box's corners in points, written to PDF /Border as both the horizontal and vertical radius. Absent means square corners.

defaultStyle.description: The text style. Absent: each style field's own default applies.

fringe.description: The insets from rect to the text box. Absent means the box is rect.

callout.description: A callout's leader line: the tip, an optional bend, and the point where it meets the box (PDF /CL). Absent means no leader line.

head.description: The line ending at a callout's tip. Absent means None.

FreeText.title: FreeText
FreeText.description: Text drawn directly on the page in a box. color is the fill of the box and defaultStyle holds the text style.

Dashes.title: Dashes
Dashes.description: A dash pattern in points: lengths on, then off, repeating (XFDF dashes, PDF /D).

fontFamily.description: The font family. Absent means Helvetica. XFDF writes it as font-family.

fontSize.description: The font size in points. Absent means 12. XFDF writes it as font-size.

color.description: The text colour. Absent: the reader chooses the text colour.

textAlign.description: How lines of text line up in the box. Absent means left. XFDF writes it as text-align.

fontWeight.description: Bold text. Absent means normal weight. XFDF writes it as font-weight.

fontStyle.description: Italic text. Absent means upright. XFDF writes it as font-style.

textDecoration.description: Underlined text. Absent means no underline. XFDF writes it as text-decoration.

FreeTextStyle.title: FreeTextStyle
FreeTextStyle.description: A free-text box's text style. The keys are the CSS property names XFDF writes in its defaultstyle string, in camel case.

left.description: Inset from the left edge in points.

top.description: Inset from the top edge in points.

right.description: Inset from the right edge in points.

bottom.description: Inset from the bottom edge in points.

Fringe.title: Fringe
Fringe.description: Insets from an annotation's rect to the area it draws in, in points (PDF /RD, XFDF fringe, both in this order).

LineEnding.title: LineEnding
LineEnding.description: The shape drawn at the end of a line (XFDF head and tail, PDF /LE). One of None, Square, Circle, Diamond, OpenArrow, ClosedArrow, Butt, ROpenArrow, RClosedArrow, Slash. Any other PDF name is allowed and is kept unchanged.

UnknownAnnotation.title: UnknownAnnotation
UnknownAnnotation.description: An annotation of a type this version of Gloss does not define, such as one from a newer writer or a host's own. It needs a type, an id and a page. Readers may ignore it or pass it through. Types match case-sensitively, so Highlight is an unknown type. Gloss never defines a type that starts with x-, so a host's own types should use that prefix: no later version can then reject them.
